headline: MEXC November Audit Shows User Assets Backed by Reserves Above 100%
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange MEXC released its November Proof of Reserves report, audited by Hacken, showing user asset reserve ratios above 100% across major assets.
why: Proof of reserves reports provide transparency on cryptocurrency exchange solvency and asset backing for user funds.

impacts.name: Digital Asset Exchanges
impacts.why: Audited reserves verify platform solvency and asset backing for traders.
